reasoning.Student A:
Because the mechanism is strategy-proof, reporting my true preferences is a dominant strategy: I cannot improve my outcome by misrepresenting my ranking regardless of what others do. My true ordering is w > z > y > x, so I should list schools in that order.

Additional notes that reinforce this choice: I have top priority at w and y (priority 1), and most other applicants favor y highly. Even so, misreporting (for example ranking y above w to try to secure y) cannot yield a better result than truthfully listing w first, and I actually prefer w to y. Therefore I submit my true ranking.
